summary: Russian forces conducted multiple missile and drone attacks across Ukraine overnight, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukraine's military reported destroying 20 ships in the Black Sea, including 17 tankers. EU sanctions negotiations against Russia failed, postponing the 21st package.

Ukrainian forces destroyed 20 ships in the Black Sea overnight, including 17 oil tankers, 2 gas tankers, and 1 tug, according to Ukrainian military intelligence. (Source: UkraineNow/82656)
EU ambassadors failed to agree on a 21st sanctions package against Russia, with talks postponed until next week. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/31656)

President Zelenskyy proposed replacing Defense Minister Reznikov with former Interior Minister Klymenko due to disagreements over war strategy and procurement decisions. (Source: UkraineNow/82674)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions overnight, causing civilian casualties in Kharkiv and targeting infrastructure. Ukraine's military intelligence reported successful destruction of 20 ships in the Black Sea, including 17 oil tankers. EU sanctions negotiations against Russia failed to reach agreement on the 21st package, delaying further economic pressure.

points: Ukrainian military forces destroyed 20 ships in the Black Sea overnight, including 17 oil tankers, 2 gas tankers, and 1 tug, according to military intelligence official Robert Brovdi who promised video confirmation. (Source: UkraineNow/82656)

President Zelenskyy announced intention to replace Defense Minister Oleksiy Reznikov with former Interior Minister Denys Klymenko due to disagreements over war strategy and procurement decisions made without proper consultation from the General Staff. (Source: UkraineNow/82674)

Defense Minister Reznikov confirmed his departure from the position, citing incomplete organizational transformation of the Ministry of Defense to NATO standards and failure to fully transition all procurement to tenders and establish accountability culture. (Source: UkraineNow/82677)

EU extended temporary protection status for Ukrainian refugees until March 2028 but imposed new conditions requiring military service obligation fulfillment for future applicants, verified by legal exit stamps or exemption documents. (Source: UkraineNow/82662)

Ukrainian forces successfully targeted Russian logistics along the front line with collection efforts for 4 long-range FPV drones to enhance strike capabilities against Russian supply lines. (Source: mon1tor_ua/68978)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating their campaign against Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian populations through coordinated missile and drone attacks across multiple regions. The deployment of long-range bombers like Tu-22M3 with Kh-22 missiles poses significant threats to critical infrastructure and population centers. Ukrainian forces demonstrate effective countermeasures with reported destruction of Russian naval assets in the Black Sea, though civilian casualties continue to mount. The failed EU sanctions agreement may embolden Russian aggression while limiting Western economic pressure capabilities.
sections.regional_response: European Union negotiations for additional sanctions against Russia failed to reach consensus, with the 21st package postponed until mid-July, potentially weakening coordinated pressure on Russian entities. NATO allies continue supporting Ukrainian defense efforts while monitoring Russian escalation patterns across multiple fronts. Regional partners express concern over Russian missile deployments and drone operations targeting civilian infrastructure. The extension of Ukrainian refugee protection by EU demonstrates continued solidarity despite ongoing conflict developments.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military operations show increased coordination between different service branches with simultaneous missile, drone, and air force deployments across Ukrainian territory. Ukrainian intelligence capabilities demonstrated effectiveness in maritime operations with successful ship destructions in the Black Sea. Political developments in both countries indicate potential changes in defense leadership structures affecting operational planning. Electronic warfare and drone technology continue evolving as primary tools for both offensive and defensive operations.
